claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Rivaroxaban is a selective, non-cytotoxic factor Xa inhibitor whose target (F10/coagulation cascade) is not required for cancer cell-intrinsic viability at 2.5 uM, so it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen with any effect limited to weak, non-selective growth inhibition.
